headline: South African Treasury Evaluates Options to Replace Fuel Levy Revenue
summary: South Africa's Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana raised the possibility of abolishing fuel taxes, though replacing R80 billion in annual government revenue presents a significant fiscal obstacle.
why: Fuel levies are a major source of revenue for South Africa's national budget alongside income and value-added taxes.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Eliminating fuel taxes reduces consumer transport costs but requires alternative taxation to avoid fiscal deficits.
